text: Who's on top of the mountain?
Did you see a wizard lately?
zh: 你最近见过一个巫师吗？

text: Don't you know that there's some bad folk up on the mountain.
zh: 你不知道山上有些不好惹的家伙吗？

text: Just consider this a... friendly warning.
zh: 就当这是个……友好的警告吧。

text: Ain't no one as nice as I am up there.
zh: 山上可没人像我这么好说话。

text: Goran is the bandit chief, and I'm talking THE bandit chief.
zh: 戈兰是强盗头子，而且是头子中的头子。

text: He used to be Balder's right hand man, but they got into a fight and Goran kicked his ass.
zh: 他以前是巴尔德的左膀右臂，后来俩人干了一架，戈兰把他揍趴下了。

text: After Balder and a few of the former bandits left the mountain, Goran took over.
zh: 巴尔德带着几个老弟兄下山之后，戈兰就接管了这里。
最近没有巫师打这儿经过。

text: Some of Balders men asked the same question and made their way to the camp on top of the mountain.
zh: 巴尔德手下有几个人也问过同样的问题，然后就往山顶的营地去了。

text: Haven't seen them since then, though.
zh: 不过从那以后就再没见过他们。
